MEMO. From: Rosa Alvarez. To: all roastery staff. Date: 3 November 2023.

Subject: night-shift sleep consultations.

From January 2024 every night-shift roaster may book a sleep consultation with Dr. Hana Sato, paid by the company.
The caffeine cut-off on the night shift stays at 2 am. Daniel Okafor will coordinate the schedule. The program was
piloted in Austin in August 2023 with eight roasters and will run in Denver from Q2 2024.
